chunks: They said: 'No. But we found our fathers doing so.'
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'we found our fathers doing so' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this verse captures the stubbornness of the disbelievers who, when challenged by their prophets, defaulted to ancestral tradition (taqlid al-ajdād) rather than engaging in rational reflection. Shia scholarship often contrasts this blind imitation with the concept of 'Aql (intellect), emphasizing that true faith requires verifying traditions against divine truth rather than merely following the status quo of previous generations.
